attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Puerto Rico territory income tax calculation. Implements separate PR tax system with progressive rates. Bona fide residents exempt from US tax on PR-source income. Act 60 provides 0% capital gains for investors, 4% business tax. Form 8898 required for bona fide residents.

initial_action.action_postfix: "PUERTO RICO TERRITORY TAX - Separate Tax System" job.audit_trail swap addto " Act 60 Tax Incentives and Bona Fide Residence Test" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.pr_income_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Bona fide resident of PR; Meets bona fide residence test (183+ days, tax home, closer connection)
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.pr_days_present 183 >= result.pr_has_tax_home and result.pr_closer_connection and dup /result.pr_bona_fide_resident xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Qualifies for Act 60 investor benefits; Act 60 investor (0% capital gains)
Qualifies for Act 60 business benefits; Act 60 business (4% rate)

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PR tax for bona fide resident with Act 60 benefits
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.pr_requires_form_8898 xdef true /result.pr_files_with_hacienda xdef
result.agi result.pr_standard_deduction_single sub 0 fmax local@ pr_taxable_income >
result.pr_act60_investor if 0.0 /result.pr_income_tax xdef " Act 60 Investor: 0% capital gains rate applied" job.audit_trail swap addto else result.pr_act60_business if pr_taxable_income 0.04 f* /result.pr_income_tax xdef " Act 60 Business: 4% flat rate applied" job.audit_trail swap addto else pr_taxable_income result.pr_bracket_1_limit fmin result.pr_bracket_1_rate f* local@ tax1 > pr_taxable_income result.pr_bracket_1_limit f- 0 fmax result.pr_bracket_2_limit result.pr_bracket_1_limit f- fmin result.pr_bracket_2_rate f* local@ tax2 > pr_taxable_income result.pr_bracket_2_limit f- 0 fmax result.pr_bracket_3_limit result.pr_bracket_2_limit f- fmin result.pr_bracket_3_rate f* local@ tax3 > pr_taxable_income result.pr_bracket_3_limit f- 0 fmax result.pr_bracket_4_limit result.pr_bracket_3_limit f- fmin result.pr_bracket_4_rate f* local@ tax4 > pr_taxable_income result.pr_bracket_4_limit f- 0 fmax result.pr_bracket_5_rate f* local@ tax5 > tax1 tax2 f+ tax3 f+ tax4 f+ tax5 f+ /result.pr_income_tax xdef " PR progressive tax calculated (0-33% brackets)" job.audit_trail swap addto then then
" Bona fide PR resident - Form 8898 required" job.audit_trail swap addto " PR-source income exempt from US federal tax" job.audit_trail swap addto " PR tax liability: $" result.pr_income_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Not bona fide resident - subject to US tax
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.pr_bona_fide_resident xdef false /result.pr_requires_form_8898 xdef 0.0 /result.pr_income_tax xdef " Not bona fide PR resident - subject to US federal income tax" job.audit_trail swap addto " Does not meet 183-day presence test or other bona fide resident requirements" job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate PR territory tax for bona fide residents with Act 60 benefits
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide PR residents are exempt from US federal tax on PR-source income per IRC 933. Act 60 provides 0% capital gains for investors, 4% business tax. Progressive rates 0-33% apply to ordinary income. Form 8898 required."

policy_statement.policy_description: Not bona fide resident - US tax applies
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Non-bona fide residents of PR are subject to US federal income tax on worldwide income. Must meet 183-day presence test, tax home in PR, and closer connection test to qualify as bona fide resident."
